review:
An East Asian fantasy duel game: a Phoenix faces a Water Dragon on every expanded reel. VS symbols expand into wild reels when they'd join a win, the survivor's multiplier covers the reel, and several reels add together.

The twist is Resurrection Spins – if the Phoenix loses at least one duel, you get a respin with at least one more duel. So losing isn't quite the end. 10,000x max, and some of the most polished art in the DuelReels series.
